'''June 2001 Buford tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Galactic Quest, Buford, GA on 9 June 2001. It is known from Zafar Tejani's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2445">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-12-z-goes-to-gq-buford-june-9-2001d2445/ z-goes-to-gq-buford-june-9-2001], DeckTech (Zafar "Zmanthe1st" Tejani, 12 June 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-12-z-goes-to-gq-buford-june-9-2001d2445/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 9 June 2001
* '''Site:''' Galactic Quest, Buford, GA
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Tatooine]]
* '''Players:''' 24
